text:
laura: Heads-up team — PR #4721 adds a migration guide + SDK example for the revamped client.auth flow. Aiming to land this into the v1.8 docs before the release cutoff. preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/pull/4721

sam: taking a look now.

mike: quick note: the feature is still behind flag auth-v1. If we publish docs prior to the flag flip customers might follow steps that don't work. Should we add a banner or hold?

laura: planned to add a banner. Also CI failed link-checks for a few internal links per docs-bot. holding until I fix.

jen: docs-bot: Preview build failed: link-checker errors: /sdk/js/auth.md -> /stable/auth (404), /migration/auth-migration.md -> /v1.7/example (redirect loop).

laura: thanks — I'll fix the /stable -> /v1.8 and break the redirect loop.

sam: snippet nit: JS example still uses old constructor new RedwoodClient(). Should be new AuthClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY }). Also add the language tag to the triple-backticks.

ash: legal flag: don't say "unbreakable encryption". change to "encrypted in transit and at rest" if we mention it.

mike: ops question: do we want to tie the docs merge to the binary release commit? if so we should schedule merge during the release window. @nate

nate: release engineer here — v1.8 docs cutoff is 2025-05-15 23:59 UTC. If docs must match the shipped artifact, pin docs to /v1.8 and merge before cutoff. If it's safe behind a flag with banner, merging earlier is acceptable but please add the flag name and rollout date.

laura: updated PR with fixes: changed links to /v1.8, updated JS snippet, legal wording adjusted. Restarted preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/pull/4721/preview/2

docs-bot: Preview build succeeded with warnings: content-note missing for feature-flagged features. Please include the ff name in the banner.

laura: banner added: "Note: features described below are gated by feature flag 'auth-v1'. Rollout begins 2025-05-12; behavior may vary until fully rolled out."

sam: looks good to me aside from one markdown heading style. non-blocking.

ash: legal approved the wording.

mike: SRE — can we do a canary docs rollout so only a portion of users see the new pages initially? 

sre-oncall: yes. We can publish a canary route and expose to ~5% via our docs routing layer. Plan: (1) merge with banner, (2) publish canary route, (3) monitor PagerDuty + link telemetry for 24h, (4) escalate to full route after green. We can also coordinate the flag flip with the release team.

nate: operational note: if you need the docs commit to be on the release branch, we'll need the merge by 2025-05-14 18:00 UTC to cut release candidate builds. Otherwise we'll reference the tagged /v1.8 docs in release notes.

laura: decision: merge after SRE signoff and CI green. Tentative merge time 2025-05-14 18:00 UTC to give release team time. I'll post here when merging. Thanks! :heart:

jen: final edits pushed, ready for final merge.

laura: will merge at scheduled time unless any blockers appear. cheers everyone.
